item.tib: bya ri gtsug ldan gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: bdag dang zhus lan byung tshul gyi/ 'khrul snang yi ger btab pa 'di/ yi dam lha la mthol lo bshags/ rig 'dzin rje la gnong ngo 'gyod/ ma sring gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams/ byang chub sems kyi don mthong nas/ dran pa nam mkha'i sa thob shog kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ phyogs bcu kun tu bkra shis shog/
